title: Extractable experiential SLEEP writer and teachability bootstrap
summary: Separate unique lived evidence, compiler views, optimizer dose, and sleep cadence; certify that experience is stored, extracted, and used without retrieval or interface harm; and test a target-blind bootstrap that may accelerate later parenting while keeping live parent text outside the personal SLEEP targets.
system_thesis: A child's grounded action-outcome experience should become a provenance-bound parametric bias that can be activated under new cues and improve later native thought/action; parenting improves the evidence stream, while SLEEP compiles and writes only supported child experience.

context_files.purpose: Binding architecture deliberation, implementation, review, and GPU gate contract.
Verbatim owner direction on extractability, dosage, parenting boundaries, repetition, and a teachability bootstrap.
Initial graph, loop, claim, visibility, and test implications.
Fresh independent interpretation of the evidence, target, compiler, extraction, and use substrate.
Fresh independent causal decomposition of dose, view history, and closed-loop cadence.
Fresh independent design for target-blind teachability schooling and its factorial test.
Fresh independent attack on phrase repetition, task leakage, and false parenting acceleration.
Cross-critique and required repairs for admission, targets, dose, cadence, bootstrap persistence, and claims.
Adjudicated exact proposal, acceptance order, and human boundary.

nodes.before: Compiler rows and deduplicated strings implicitly stand in for evidence.
nodes.after: One immutable evidence identity represents each valid public dispatch/outcome, while supported lesson bundles and derived training views have separate identities and counts.
nodes.rationale: Truth, independent experience, compiler augmentation, and SGD dose must not be conflated.

nodes.before: Legacy selection emits winners, generic QA, episodic anchors, contrasts, and free principles without a complete provenance or equal-dose contract.
nodes.after: The compiler emits provenance-bound child-native targets under exact, alternative, state-only, and grounded contrast cues; unsupported explanations and free principles are excluded from the minimum writer.
nodes.rationale: The first writer must train extraction and native use while preserving what public evidence actually supports.

nodes.before: Writer variants differ in loss surface, row count, optimizer exposure, seeds, and code path; own-row fit is treated as absorption.
nodes.after: One response-masked writer records supervised target tokens, optimizer steps, order/batches, seeds, rank/alpha, update magnitude, and transactional preservation gates; source fit, held-out extraction, and use are separate.
nodes.rationale: A fitted corpus can remain inaccessible or behaviorally harmful.

nodes.before: The base child is expected to infer how to turn sparse parenting into self-generated learning behavior during the same childhood.
nodes.after: A separately identified target-blind schooling corpus may create a frozen schooled birth checkpoint that practices general feedback-to-thought-to-action computations across unrelated microdomains.
nodes.rationale: A modest general learning prior may raise parenting bandwidth without contaminating personal SLEEP or final tasks.

nodes.before: Repetition can be operationalized as forcing the same first NOTE and measuring lexical overlap.
nodes.after: The parent repeats a core computation across varied relevant cases; reminders fade after unprompted behavioral uptake and return on relapse. Parent messages remain context-only and loss-masked.
nodes.rationale: Phrase echo can manufacture the metric and reproduce ritual collapse.

edges.after: Every compiler view resolves through one supported lesson to ordered immutable public evidence IDs; views change dose, never evidence count.
edges.rationale: This is the provenance spine required for honest augmentation and causal controls.

edges.before: Every personal writer starts from the original product base.
edges.after: Bootstrap arms start every cumulative personal write from one frozen schooled birth checkpoint; neutral arms start from their matched frozen neutral checkpoint.
edges.rationale: The general schooling prior persists without replaying live parent messages into personal SLEEP.

edges.before: A parent brief may be proposed as a direct SLEEP corpus stratum.
edges.after: Parent text affects SLEEP only indirectly through later child-authored, executed, publicly evaluated thought/action experience; parent tokens remain masked and are never personal targets.
edges.rationale: Parenting must change the child's cognition rather than become ordinary imitation of teacher prose.

loops.before: Compile a cumulative text corpus, train a fresh LoRA from base, and gate mainly on format/task probes.
loops.after: Index public evidence, form support-scoped lessons, render dose-counted native views, train from the lineage birth checkpoint under an exact response-loss budget, and atomically commit only if extraction/use/interface/no-harm gates pass against the previous child.
loops.trigger: A preregistered evidence or time threshold is reached after the exact writer has passed the static assay.
writes: candidate personal LoRA and exact training receipt
storage extraction use and preservation evidence
loops.stop_condition: Stop and retain the previous child on provenance failure, source mismatch, nonfinite training, action/interface failure, work-turn collapse, generic degradation, or adverse task margin.
loops.rationale: The write is useful only if grounded experience remains accessible to native future action without corrupting the agent.

loops.before: No separately identified schooling stage or causal test of receptivity.
loops.after: Create matched neutral and teachability birth checkpoints, cross each with parent absent/present development, repeat computations across varied relevant tasks, fade on behavioral uptake, and measure entry-adjusted parenting acceleration on disposable parent-absent exams.
loops.trigger: The static personal writer passes and a separately ratified target-blind bootstrap corpus and 2x2 execution packet are source-bound.
reads: frozen parenting policy and exam specification
loops.stop_condition: Stop for final-task leakage, phrase-only uptake, wrong-advice invariance, no interaction after the preregistered horizon, or material interface/generic harm.
loops.rationale: The factorial distinguishes being better at birth from becoming more teachable.

loops.before: Periodic lives and large one-shot adapters with different writers and doses may be compared narratively.
loops.after: Only after writer certification, compare matched periodic K4 and delayed K1 lives and standardized terminal adapters from their ledgers to decompose total package cadence from changed future evidence and historical rendering.
loops.trigger: The compiler surface and rank/plasticity recipe are frozen and independently approved for prospective GPU execution.
reads: matched life tasks and occurrence-aware seeds
periodic and delayed canonical evidence ledgers
writes: checkpoint AUC and total cadence contrast
loops.stop_condition: Stop for repeated material harm, identity mismatch, seed failure, or exhausted preregistered maximum roots without resolution.
loops.rationale: Cadence matters through the live feedback loop, not through a mystical endpoint write-frequency effect.

claims.before: R2 long lives and the write swarm certify the intended native response-masked writer and augmentation recipe.
claims.after: R2 characterizes the old compile_sleep/v1 writer and the swarm is dose-confounded; neither certifies the intended writer.
claims.evidence_needed: Direct source/remote receipt audit plus a future source-bound matched assay of the intended compiler/trainer.

claims.before: No current evidence separates corpus fit from retrieval-free extraction and fresh-task use.
claims.after: Conditional on passing exact assays, a provenance-bound personal LoRA makes selected lived lessons recoverable under held-out cues and improves native action on fresh homologous tasks without textual memory.
claims.evidence_needed: Dose-matched compiler factorial, multiple training blocks, held-out cue extraction, fresh identifiers/combinations, previous-child/base and derangement/shuffle/wrong-life controls, and preservation gates.

claims.before: Bootstrap may improve initial behavior or dialect without changing teachability.
claims.after: Conditional on a positive preregistered difference-in-differences and time-to-threshold result, the target-blind learning-habit bootstrap accelerates later parenting beyond its entry-level effect.
claims.evidence_needed: Neutral-vs-teachability bootstrap x parent-absent-vs-present paired developmental roots, phrase-echo and wrong/shuffled advice controls, context reset, and safety gates.

claims.before: Current periodic-versus-one-shot comparisons conflate writer, dose, data, seeds, briefs, and policy.
claims.after: Conditional on the prospective K4/K1 package contrast and mediation analysis, earlier SLEEP availability changes later evidence and lifetime performance under the frozen system.
claims.evidence_needed: Matched prospective lives, standardized terminal adapters from both ledgers, checkpoint AUC, independent roots, and practical-margin intervals.

cells.reason: It is the only grounded content authority for the schooling corpus.
The trainer sees only frozen rendered rows and manifests.
Development uses fresh tasks, not replayed schooling demonstrations.
Personal SLEEP compiles current child experience, not bootstrap source examples.
Disposable exams use unseen homologous items.
Final evaluation is independent of bootstrap construction data.
Static process guidance may condition demonstrations but is loss-masked and source-bound.
Only frozen masked prompt tokens may appear; they are never targets.
The child must receive the current parent lesson in active context.
Longitudinal parent text cannot become a personal SLEEP target or view.
Primary uptake exams are parent-absent.
Only audited parent-present final cells see root-local messages under the frozen policy.
The bootstrap precedes the child's personal life.
Personal experience cannot contaminate the birth checkpoint.
The child and bounded parent state use current public developmental history.
It is the sole authority for personal compiler lessons and targets.
Evaluation clones test parametric retention without ledger retrieval.
Final roots begin with sealed adult weights and empty active context, not private childhood text.
The bootstrap must be target-blind and task-independent.
No final vocabulary, action, task, reward, or answer may shape schooling.
Childhood cannot practice final sealed tasks.
Pre-final personal writes cannot contain final evaluation content.
Development exams are selection data and separate from final tasks.
Only isolated final root environments and scorers reveal their assigned public tasks/outcomes.
Validated schooling views are generated from target-blind evidence under the frozen renderer.
The trainer consumes the exact frozen response-masked rows.
The waking child sees tasks and parent messages, not its training corpus.
The compiler creates views after evidence selection and before training.
Exams cannot retrieve or expose the training rows.
Final cognition must use weights rather than training-row access.

acceptance_tests.setup: Validate this change, all normative source hashes, requested scope, and a later exact implementation packet before any code or execution.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only explicit human approval of unchanged exact bytes releases its exact scope; every later normative change restarts the gate.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Inferred, stale, widened, or post-hoc authority invalidates implementation and evidence.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future intake ratification receipt and exact source manifest.

acceptance_tests.setup: Generate success, failure, corrective, generalized, duplicated, shuffled, unsupported, and cross-life cases and independently resolve every view to public evidence.
acceptance_tests.expected: Evidence, lessons, views, and exposures remain separately counted; unsupported scope or identity is rejected.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any compiler view without exact sufficient public support or any augmented view counted as independent experience falsifies provenance.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future compiler identity fixture and dual-validator report.

acceptance_tests.setup: Render every compiler 2x2 cell and compare prompt masks, response targets, supervised tokens, batch boundaries, updates, LR schedule, seeds, rank/alpha, anchors, and row order.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only the declared cue-diversity and state-only mixture factors differ; dose residual stays within the preregistered tolerance.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Parent/outcome/provenance target leakage or unmatched optimizer exposure invalidates the factorial.

acceptance_tests.setup: After clean reload/reset, measure source fit, held-out cue recovery without text memory, and free native action on fresh homologous tasks separately.
acceptance_tests.expected: Each result is reported independently; extraction/use claims require their own practical-margin evidence beyond source fit.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Calling lower training NLL experiential use, or extraction without fresh behavior learning, invalidates the claim.

acceptance_tests.setup: Compare correct adapters with state-target derangement, action/outcome shuffle, wrong-life adapter, equal-dose repetition, and adapter-off/previous child.
acceptance_tests.expected: A bound experiential effect disappears or redirects under semantic interventions but survives matched sham formatting/dose.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: An unchanged gain under wrong bindings supports style, prior, or dose rather than lived knowledge.

acceptance_tests.setup: Compare each candidate with the previous child on identical seeded real contexts for action format, work turns, generic anchors, and task score before atomic promotion.
acceptance_tests.expected: A harmful or collapsed candidate is rejected and no rejected corpus, brief, or adapter becomes a canonical ancestor.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any silent interface/generic degradation, below-previous replacement, or rejected-state leakage invalidates unattended SLEEP.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future commit/rollback fault and behavior report.

acceptance_tests.setup: Scan and adversarially mutate final-task vocabulary, actions, identifiers, scores, keys, and answers while rebuilding the bootstrap and neutral corpora.
acceptance_tests.expected: Bootstrap bytes are independent of final content; teacher prompt tokens are masked and the neutral corpus is surface/token matched.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any final-task information or teacher-target leakage turns the bootstrap into task post-training.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future bootstrap leakage and mask audit.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run the neutral/teachability bootstrap x parent absent/present 2x2 on paired roots with disposable parent-absent exams and wrong/shuffled-advice controls.
acceptance_tests.expected: Entry improvement and parenting acceleration are separated; uptake is unprompted, relevant, behavior-changing, outcome-improving, and retained after reset.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Phrase echo, pure entry-level gain, advice-insensitive gain, or no preregistered interaction falsifies accelerated teachability.

acceptance_tests.setup: After compiler selection, cross rank 8/16 with low/high supervised target-token exposure under matched evidence, seeds, and evaluation.
acceptance_tests.expected: Select the smallest safe rank using extraction/use, delta norm, anchor distribution drift, and interface/task harm.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Choosing rank as update strength or an age schedule without interaction evidence invalidates the capacity claim.

acceptance_tests.setup: Compare periodic K4 and delayed K1 matched lives plus standardized terminal adapters from both canonical ledgers, with briefs disabled or separately controlled.
acceptance_tests.expected: Report total package cadence, future-evidence mediation, historical rendering, and checkpoint AUC separately.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Failure beyond the practical margin rejects the relevant cadence claim; mismatched writer/dose/data cannot support it.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future prospective cadence and mediation report.

acceptance_tests.setup: Write an early supported lesson cohort, exclude it from later replay, perform unrelated writes, reset context, and probe held-out cues and behavior.
acceptance_tests.expected: Retention is reported only if extraction/use survives without continued rehearsal.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Loss after replay removal shows rehearsal-dependent maintenance rather than retained memory.

acceptance_tests.setup: After scoped implementation and CPU preflight, a fresh reviewer and separate author-side advocate inspect exact sources, fixtures, manifests, budgets, and claims before GPU dispatch.
acceptance_tests.expected: GPU execution occurs only on an independently accepted, human-ratified exact packet; advocate cannot override rejection.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Implementation self-certification, stale review, or unapproved dispatch invalidates the run.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future independent review, advocate response, and GPU authorization receipt.

human_boundary.decision_question: Ratify the proposal to certify a provenance-bound extractable personal writer first, then test a target-blind teachability bootstrap, rank/plasticity, and finally closed-loop cadence under the exact acceptance order and thinker/compiler visibility boundary?
forbidden_before_approval: inference of approval from conceptual agreement
promotion of R2 or the write swarm as certification
